title: Spell
wikitext:
{{redirect|Spell Damage|the passive skill|Spell Damage (passive skill)}}

'''Spells''' are skills that are cast or triggered by the user which can deal damage to an enemy or apply positive or negative effects to the caster, allies, or enemies. It is one of the two major categories for skills, the other being [[attack]]s. Unlike attacks, spells are not affected by [[accuracy]] or [[evasion]]. 

Additionally, spell damage is one of four [[damage source]]s. Most spells that can deal damage with hits deal spell damage unless stated otherwise. Spell damage can be specifically mitigated by [[spell suppression]].

==Related skill gems==
{{main|List of skill gems dealing spell damage}}
{{:List_of_skill_gems_dealing_spell_damage}}

===Spell damage scaling other damage sources===
Certain stats can allow modifiers (increases/reductions, more/less) spell damage to scale other damage sources such as [[attack]]s or [[damage over time]]. This does not mean that attack damage or damage over time count as spell damage.

====Spell damage applies to attacks====
Attack skill gems that are affected by increases and reductions to spell damage.

{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables = skill_stats_per_level
|join = skill._pageID=skill_stats_per_level._pageID
|where = skill_stats_per_level.id = "active_skill_additive_spell_damage_modifiers_apply_to_attack_damage_at_%_value"
}}

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName
|where = item_stats.id LIKE "%spell_damage%apply_to_attack%"
|large=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}
	
{{Query masteries|where=mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%Spell Damage also apply to Attack%"}}

====Spell damage applies to damage over time====
{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables = skill_stats_per_level
|join = skill._pageID=skill_stats_per_level._pageID
|where = skill_stats_per_level.id = "spell_damage_modifiers_apply_to_skill_dot"
}}

==Base items==
===Spell damage===
Some base items increase spell damage by a percentage.

{{Drop enabled base item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName
|where = 
    item_stats.id LIKE "%spell_damage_+%"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=% increased Spell Damage
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=spell_damage_+%
}}

==Unique items==
===Spell damage===
Some [[unique item]]s increase or reduce spell damage by a percentage.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName
|where = 
    item_stats.id LIKE "%spell_damage_+%"
 OR items.name = "Mantra of Flames"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=% increased Spell Damage
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=spell_damage_+%
|stat_column1_stat2_id=spell_damage_+%_while_no_mana_reserved
|stat_column1_stat3_id=local_unique_jewel_notable_passives_in_radius_instead_grant_spell_damage_+%
|stat_column1_stat4_id=spell_damage_+%_per_10_int
|stat_column1_stat5_id=spell_damage_+%_per_5%_block_chance
|stat_column1_stat6_id=spell_damage_+%_if_have_crit_recently
|stat_column1_stat7_id=spell_damage_+%_per_power_charge
|stat_column1_stat8_id=spell_damage_+%_per_100_max_life
|stat_column1_stat9_id=spell_damage_+%_per_200_mana_spent_recently
|stat_column1_stat10_id=spell_damage_+%_if_other_ring_is_elder_item
}}

==Related passive skills==
===Spell Damage===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "spell_damage_+%"
}}

===Spell critical strike chance===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "spell_critical_strike_chance_+%"
}}

===Spell critical strike multiplier===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "base_spell_critical_strike_multiplier_+"
}}

===Miscellaneous===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%spell%"
  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%spell_block%"
  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("spell_damage_+%","spell_critical_strike_chance_+%","base_spell_critical_strike_multiplier_+")
}}

===Historic keystone passive skills===
The following [[Historic]] jewel [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to spells:
{{Passive skill table
|q_where = ( passive_skills.id LIKE "%karui_keystone%" 
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%templar_keystone%" 
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%vaal_keystone%" 
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%maraketh_keystone%" 
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%eternal_keystone%" 
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%kalguur_keystone%"
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%abyss%keystone%" ) AND 
passive_skills.name !="The Agnostic" AND
passive_skills.name !="Glancing Blows" AND
passive_skills.name !="Supreme Ego" AND
passive_skills.name !="Wind Dancer" AND
passive_skills.name !="Eternal Youth" AND 
passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%spell%"
|stat_text=1
|large=1
}}

===Keystone passive skills===
The following [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to spells:
{{Query keystone passive skills
|where=
  passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Spell%" 
 AND passive_skills.stat_text NOT LIKE "100% increased Spell Damage while not on Low Mana" 
 AND passive_skills.id NOT LIKE "%mana_damage_keystone2169%" 
 AND passive_skills.id NOT LIKE "%power_charge_keystone2172%" 
}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%spell%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}
